producer: Runtime simulation owner after selecting the update view
consumers: TGUI; RmlUi; additional UI modules; layout services
current_path: Runtime transfers dimensions in ticks; applications feed each session manually.
change: Publish one committed logical/framebuffer pair and bind context-created UI sessions; preserve explicit manual views.
consequences: Required listeners must complete before the matching update; queued native resize is not tick-coherent; initial seed and failure policy are required.
prerequisites: Context-reachable current-view/subscription source; copied identity and revision; compatible session owner; owned subscription cleanup.
acceptance: Both runtime modes; late creation without resize; logical-only changes; zero extents; manual mode; failure and teardown.

consumers: Existing native resize listeners; asynchronous size observers
current_path: Named notification precedes typed WindowResized; payload copies pixel size and borrows Window.
change: Preserve native publication and compatibility while E01 provides committed simulation view state.
consequences: Nested legacy callbacks can invert typed observations; legacy failure can suppress typed dispatch; queued pointer remains borrowed; no tick-coherence promise.
prerequisites: Consumers choose an owner and respect borrowed pointer lifetime; E01 is a different commit boundary.
acceptance: Retain existing named/typed ordering and native failure behavior.

documentation: Internal implementation unless modules subscribe directly
producer: Runtime at safe platform observation phase
consumers: Runtime-owned renderer integration; optional platform policies
current_path: Both run modes compare sampled framebuffer size and directly set the renderer viewport.
change: Consider centralizing platform snapshot publication and replacing duplicated viewport application with a required runtime-owned listener.
consequences: Viewport must update before rendering even without simulation updates; raw native callbacks and queued platform delivery change the failure/progress boundary.
prerequisites: Choose the smaller refactor benefit; install and seed after renderer startup; immediate platform execution; detach before renderer shutdown; retain resize accounting.
acceptance: No-update rendering; initial seed; logical-only filtering; owner/current context; listener failure and teardown.

producer: Platform input observation after completed poll
consumers: Pause policy; audio policy; UI modules
current_path: GLFW_FOCUSED changes are sampled and logged; keyboard routing is handled separately.
change: Publish copied native focus and current-state seeding with source and poll/revision identity.
consequences: Sampled state cannot promise every transient; queued observation is asynchronous relative to input consumption; automatic blur must preserve previously captured input.
prerequisites: Portable current focus; staged publication after poll completion; explicit consumption ordering for input-dependent policies.
acceptance: Initial state; repeated state suppression; backlog; owner delivery; old focus-epoch records survive.

producer: Platform input adapter after complete poll publication
consumers: Reconnect UI; controller assignment; gameplay policy; device modules
current_path: Availability changes are logged; backend snapshot is queryable; input reconciles neutral controls.
change: Publish availability with portable source/device identity and attachment generation; add current-state seeding.
consequences: Keep neutralization in input; neutral state does not prove absence; generic API represents one convenience pad; ordinary queued delivery is not input-batch alignment.
prerequisites: Completed-poll metadata; initial/reattachment rules; poll-coupled handoff if policy requires matching input; no duplicate publication at two boundaries.
acceptance: Initial presence; sampled disconnect/reconnect; neutral controls; backlog/recovery ordering; late subscribers and teardown.

current_path: Voice state sampling detects Finished; maintenance reclaims unreferenced inactive voices; no completion subscription.
change: Detect and deduplicate completion for relevant playbacks; emit owned records outside the audio mutex.
consequences: Current maintenance is not a sweep of retained voices; handlers may start another sound; restart replaces voice data; mixer dispatch is unsuitable.
prerequisites: Explicit maintenance cadence/owner; system/voice/playback generation; stop/loop/close distinctions and unobserved-completion policy.
acceptance: Retained voice completion once per generation; restart race; next-sound reentry outside lock; latency and close semantics.

producer: Resource mutation owner after commit and unlock
consumers: Resource modules; asset browsers; reload coordinators; dependent caches
current_path: Caches publish/replace under locks; old handles remain valid; metadata callback is internal and nonthrowing.
change: Publish copied key/domain/generation changes after commit; include an explicit reset contract; fold successful shader reload into this family.
consequences: Do not dispatch under cache locks or replace atomic metadata work; observer failure must not turn successful replacement into load failure; immutable handles do not auto-rebind.
prerequisites: Ordered publication owner; independent observation failure path; explicit reset/source closure; no throwing destructor dispatch; loss recovery.
acceptance: After-unlock observer reentry; committed-only changes; retained generations; successful replacement despite notification failure; reset and resynchronization.

producer: Upload owner after outcome/statistics commit and unlock
consumers: Independent loading UI; loading coordinators; resource modules
current_path: Upload returns or throws; synchronized last-attempt stats and logs record completion/partial publication.
change: Add one owned terminal batch outcome with loader/batch/provider identity; retain requester result and direct CPU preparation.
consequences: Current finish is noexcept; notification failure must not terminate or replace the original exception; typed-cache counts are not an atomic registry/resource snapshot.
prerequisites: Contained observation errors; counts-valid/unknown semantics; stage and failure identity; no claim that zero counted publications means no side effects.
acceptance: Success; partial failure; unknown counts; registry effects; overwritten last-attempt state; original failure preserved.

producer: Runtime control owner at admission and terminal outcome
current_path: Direct game hooks, stop tokens, cleanup and run return/exception already govern runtime control.
change: Add admission/outcome observations; define exact commit points before exposing finer readiness/quiescence milestones.
consequences: Retain mandatory control calls and barriers; terminal outcome cannot queue onto runtime-owned dispatchers after closure; optional notification must preserve the primary runtime failure.
prerequisites: Scoped session identity and state model; immediate terminal delivery or independently live host endpoint; queued platform/simulation use only while target is serviced.
acceptance: Stop-before-start; partial initialization; thread-start failure; normal exit; ordered terminal outcome; observer-error precedence and cleanup.

documentation: Internal implementation initially; document if separately developed modules depend on it
producer: Simulation timing owner or platform pressure owner
consumers: Runtime policy coordination; internal monitors; optional adaptive modules
current_path: Lag-warning and input-backpressure-warning states already report degradation and recovery.
change: Publish coalesced state-entry/recovery notifications; retain current thresholds, reporting cadence, counters and logs.
consequences: Repeated warning logs must not repeat state events; reporting functions are noexcept; cross-owner policy applies at a defined later decision boundary.
prerequisites: Source/session identity and pressure kind; transition deduplication; contained preparation/observer failures; optional current-state seed; closure distinct from recovery.
acceptance: Entry/recovery once; unchanged reports suppressed; sampling preserved; owner delivery; shutdown under pressure; no reporting-boundary exception.
